sentences.text: Yes, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh.
The documents state that paragraph 261 applies to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, and paragraph 261(2)(ii) is the specific provision for a Tier 3 UCB.
The older 2025 pre-payment charge directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
